info.title: Showpass Organizer Gift Card Configuration API
info.description: Manage gift card designs and denominations. This contract covers configuration only.

get.description: The key must belong to this organization and its employee must retain Manage Organization Info or All Access. Active designs are shown by default. Use show=all to include inactive designs. Use q to search by name. Results are paginated and ordered by ID by default. Page reads can reflect intervening edits.

parameters.name: is_active
parameters.description: Use true for active designs (default) or false for inactive designs.

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Sort by a field, for example id or -id.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page requests are independent and may reflect intervening edits.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Page requests are independent and may reflect intervening edits.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search gift card design names.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Use all to return both active and inactive designs. Overrides is_active.

parameters.name: venue_id
parameters.description: Organization ID bound to the key.

Send the complete denominations array and set venue on each row to the organization in the path. Include IDs for existing rows on this design and omit id for new rows. Omitted rows are removed when possible. Check saved denominations before retrying.

background_color.description: The background color of the gift card for display purposes. Applies to all denominations.

anyOf.description: Base64 image with an optional data URI prefix, or an existing Showpass media URL.

base64Data.description: Base64 image with an optional data URI prefix, or an existing Showpass media URL.

uploadedImage.description: Base64 image with an optional data URI prefix, or an existing Showpass media URL.

url.description: Base64 image with an optional data URI prefix, or an existing Showpass media URL.

path.description: Base64 image with an optional data URI prefix, or an existing Showpass media URL.

image_logo.description: Logo shared by all denominations. Send null to clear it. Raster images must be 80 to 500 pixels wide and 80 to 500 pixels high, with a maximum file size of 3 MB.
